topic: Data retention period for device sessions
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on cleaning up the `device_session_concept` table by removing old session data. The current data spans back to January 1, 2020. Someone asked if it was safe to limit the retention period to one year. [p1] confirmed that they do not look at data from 2020 and confirmed that aggregated data will remain available.
decisions: The `device_session_concept` table can be cleaned up by removing data older than one year.
